title: Citation Schema
description: A reusable citation object used throughout the Forge knowledge base to reference factual statements, benchmarks, recommendations, and technologies.

type.title: Citation Type
type.description: The category or format of the cited resource.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title of the cited resource.

source.title: Source
source.description: Organization or publisher responsible for the resource.

authors.title: Authors
authors.description: The authors or creators of the cited resource.

url.title: URL
url.description: The web address where the resource can be accessed.

publication_date.title: Publication Date
publication_date.description: The date when the resource was originally published.

accessed_at.title: Accessed At
accessed_at.description: The timestamp when the resource was accessed or retrieved.

license.title: License
license.description: The license under which the resource is provided.

credibility.title: Credibility
credibility.description: The assessed credibility level of the source.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Additional context or notes regarding the citation.
